description: Defines the WorkerHost class responsible for managing worker processes in the Playwright test runner, including starting, stopping, messaging, and handling worker-specific configurations.

classes.name: WorkerHost
classes.description: A class extending ProcessHost that manages a worker process, including initialization, messaging, and cleanup.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a WorkerHost instance with test group info and options, setting up environment and parameters.

methods.name: artifactsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for artifacts related to this worker.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates artifacts directory and starts the worker process.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Cleans up artifacts directory upon process exit.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the worker process, marking failure if applicable.

methods.name: runTestGroup
methods.description: Sends a message to run a specific test group.

methods.name: sendCustomMessage
methods.description: Sends a custom message to the worker and returns the response.

methods.name: sendResume
methods.description: Sends a resume message to the worker.

methods.name: projectId
methods.description: Returns the project ID associated with the worker.

methods.name: didFail
methods.description: Indicates whether the worker has failed.
